cloud_model_item.description: The cloud model for item reads (Firebase AI Logic, Gemini Developer API).

cloud_model_item_fallback.description: Tried once when the item model still answers 500 or 503 after its retry; empty turns it off.

cloud_model_text.description: The cloud model for customs descriptions and listing reads.

kill_cloud.description: true pauses every cloud call (reads, second looks, descriptions); checks on the device keep working.

minimum_version_ios.description: The lowest iPhone app version that may run; 0.0.0 asks no one to update.

minimum_version_android.description: The lowest Android app version that may run; 0.0.0 asks no one to update.
